paths.description: Homepage and primary weather overview; global header, consent, main forecast, navigation, preference and mobile conditions.
Interactive rain-radar archetype and repeated-scroll memory exercise.
Forecast listing/detail archetype with two-week tabular weather information.
Emergency-information archetype for time-sensitive earthquake content.
News/content listing archetype and no-JavaScript crawler comparison.
Recovery state for an invalid public URL.

findings.summary: A consent wall obscures every tested primary page on first load
findings.evidence: Desktop and 360 px screenshots on the homepage, radar, forecast, earthquake, and news paths show a full-page modal before any weather content can be used. The first layer offers Consent and Manage options but no immediate reject action.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep essential weather content available before consent; offer equally prominent accept and reject choices, and reserve a modal interruption only when legally necessary.

findings.summary: The site ignores the user’s dark color-scheme preference
findings.evidence: The default and prefers-color-scheme: dark screenshots are byte-identical (298,988 bytes), and the page remains a hard-coded light interface.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and use system-driven theme tokens or light-dark() for surfaces, text, controls, and browser chrome.

findings.summary: Route changes have no transition continuity
findings.evidence: The platform probe found no view-transition CSS and the site uses conventional full-document navigation across the representative forecast, radar, earthquake, and news routes.
findings.suggestedFix: Add cross-document View Transitions for same-origin route changes with a no-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Important images and links lack accessible names and document structure is malformed
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility scored 0.78 and failed image-alt, link-name, and listitem. The image probe counted 97 of 100 images without alt; Lighthouse identified news links with no discernible name and li elements outside lists.
findings.suggestedFix: Give meaningful images concise alt text, decorative images alt="", name icon-only and news links, and place list items in ul/ol/menu containers.

findings.summary: Weather labels and consent text fail minimum contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found ratios of 3.29–3.70:1 for date/tab labels that require 4.5:1, plus consent text as low as 1.82:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust text and surface tokens to meet WCAG AA in every state, then re-run contrast checks in default and forced-color modes.

findings.summary: Mobile zoom is disabled and many controls are undersized
findings.evidence: The page sends user-scalable=no and maximum-scale=1.0; Lighthouse failed meta-viewport. The mobile probe found many 30–36 px controls below a 44 px touch target.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove user-scalable=no/maximum-scale, retain width=device-width, and enlarge or space touch targets to at least 44 CSS px where practical.

findings.summary: Lab performance misses the modern loading bar
findings.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse performance was 0.57 with LCP 12.1 s, Speed Index 7.2 s, TBT 330 ms, and TTI 19.5 s. The desktop trace was healthier at LCP 1.49 s, showing a material device/network sensitivity.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the true LCP resource, defer non-critical scripts, and break long work into scheduled chunks; verify on mobile throttling.

findings.summary: The critical path ships heavy, blocking, and weakly cached resources
findings.evidence: The HAR recorded 176 requests and 3.22 MB transferred. Lighthouse estimated 693 KiB unused JS, 430 ms render-blocking savings, 1,521 KiB cache savings, and 847 KiB image savings. Parser-inserted jQuery and site scripts were confirmed without async/defer/module.
findings.suggestedFix: Split and defer non-critical code, remove duplicate analytics bundles, consolidate critical CSS, set durable cache headers on versioned assets, and preload only the LCP asset.

findings.summary: Image markup and delivery waste bandwidth and risk shifts
findings.evidence: The image audit found 58 images without dimensions, 15 oversized, 12 legacy-format images, and 8 without responsive sources; Lighthouse also failed unsized-images and estimated 847 KiB savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Set width/height or aspect-ratio, emit responsive srcset/sizes, and serve appropriately compressed AVIF/WebP variants.

findings.summary: The page throws a production console error and uses deprecated unload handling
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured TypeError: googletag.pubads is not a function at the homepage and an unload listener from jQuery 3.0.0; the unload handler also blocks BFCache.
findings.suggestedFix: Guard ad bootstrap ordering, update/remove obsolete jQuery integration, replace unload with pagehide/visibilitychange where needed, and restore BFCache eligibility.

findings.summary: Baseline browser security headers and secure cookie attributes are absent
findings.evidence: The HTTPS document had no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy. All seven observed first-party cookies lacked Secure and used SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a nonce/hash-based CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, strict referrer and permissions policies; mark HTTPS cookies Secure and choose Lax/Strict unless cross-site use is required.

findings.summary: The first load has a disproportionate advertising and tracking footprint
findings.evidence: The tracker audit saw 20 third-party origins and six known tracker domains. The consent UI lists 210 partners, while the HAR shows multiple Google Analytics/Tag Manager bundles plus PubMatic, DoubleClick, and Amazon ad traffic.
findings.suggestedFix: Block non-essential vendors until an informed choice, minimise the vendor list, consolidate analytics, and batch only the measurements needed for declared purposes.

findings.summary: Core radar and news content collapses without JavaScript
findings.evidence: Discoverability found only 6% raw/rendered word coverage for radar and 0% for news, classifying both as JS shells; homepage coverage was only 14% despite raw title and h1.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render current forecast, radar summary, emergency status, and article-list content; enhance interactive maps and filters after that baseline.

findings.summary: The not-found state is a dead end
findings.evidence: A deliberately invalid route returns a bare “404 Not Found” page with no site navigation, search, weather fallback, explanation in Japanese, or recovery link.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a branded, localized 404 with weather search, home/emergency links, and a clear explanation while preserving a real 404 status.

findings.summary: The 3.22 MB first load is dominated by scripts, images, and ad technology
findings.evidence: HAR totals were 1.39 MB script and 1.51 MB image across 176 requests; the largest scripts are ad bidding, DoubleClick, and three Google analytics/tag bundles.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a per-template transfer budget, remove redundant tags, defer ads below core weather content, and optimise/cap live thumbnails.

findings.summary: The interactive radar starts with an unusually large DOM/heap footprint and grows after repeated scrolling
findings.evidence: The baseline radar heap held 802,550 nodes and 44.6 MB self size. After ten end-to-end scroll cycles a fresh post snapshot held 832,244 nodes and 48.1 MB (+29,694 nodes, +3.50 MB). No Detached constructor appeared in the summaries, so leak attribution remains medium-confidence.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile retained paths in one long-lived session, remove hidden CMP/vendor DOM after choice, virtualise or recycle map/list nodes, and clear observers/timers on teardown.

taskList.title: Make weather content available before consent and provide symmetric accept/reject choices
Restore accessible names, semantics, zoom, targets, and contrast
Reduce mobile LCP and the script/ad critical path
Deploy browser security policies and secure cookie attributes
Server-render core weather, radar summaries, and news listings
Profile and reduce radar/CMP memory retention
Add dark mode and route-transition continuity
Fix production errors, BFCache, and the localized 404
